description.en-US: Volume 4 of Newman's Parochial and Plain Sermons: 23 of the sermons he preached at St. Mary's, Oxford and Littlemore as an Anglican vicar. Newman reissued the series unchanged in 1868, as a Catholic, through his friend William John Copeland; this is the Longmans text. The sermons are on holiness, faith, the Christian year, the saints and the life of obedience.
description.pt-BR: Volume 4 dos Parochial and Plain Sermons de Newman: 23 dos sermões que ele pregou em Santa Maria, Oxford, e em Littlemore, como vigário anglicano. Newman reeditou a série sem alterações em 1868, já católico, por meio do amigo William John Copeland; este é o texto da Longmans. Os sermões tratam da santidade, da fé, do ano cristão, dos santos e da vida de obediência.

en-US.editor: John Henry Newman, ed. William John Copeland (Rivingtons, 1868; Newman Reader)

sources.edition: Parochial and Plain Sermons, vol. 4 (London: Rivingtons, 1868 edition of the series first published 1834-1843), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
sources.description: 23 chapters: Newman Reader page numbers, navigation and its editorial remarks are dropped; Newman's own notes are kept as footnotes. Anglican-period sermons, reissued by Newman in 1868. Raw page text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Newman died in 1890 and the text is of a Longmans impression (or earlier edition) before 1930. The Newman Reader page footers claim copyright in the site's transcription (c) 2007 NINS; a plain transcription of a public-domain text adds no authorship under US law.
